Face reader used by NomNoms Baby Tales (runs entirely in the browser).

human.esm.js
  @vladmandic/human 3.3.6 (https://github.com/vladmandic/human).
  MIT License: see LICENSE-human.txt.
  It bundles TensorFlow.js 4.22.0 (https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs),
  Apache License 2.0: see LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt.

models/  (the library's own licence does not cover these; each keeps the
          licence of its original source)

  selfie.json, selfie.bin  (person outline)
    MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation (Google), converted by PINTO0309's model zoo
    and by vladmandic. Apache License 2.0, per Google's model card for MediaPipe
    Selfie Segmentation: see LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt.

  blazeface.json/.bin, facemesh.json/.bin, iris.json/.bin  (face, face points, irises)
    Google MediaPipe models (BlazeFace, Face Mesh, Iris), converted by vladmandic,
    per each file's own metadata. Google's MediaPipe model cards that could be
    checked state Apache License 2.0, but the cards for these exact versions have
    not yet been confirmed. UNRESOLVED: confirm before relying on this notice.

No age, gender or face-recognition model is included. (An age model, "faceres",
was removed in October 2026 because its commercial-use terms could not be
confirmed.)

Photos given to these models are read on the device: they are not uploaded,
and they are not saved.
